front: Not until recently did scientists fully understand the mechanism.
back: 直到最近，科学家才完全了解这一机制。（倒装句：not until置句首，主句倒装）

front: It is the context rather than the content that determines meaning.
back: 正是语境而非内容决定了意义。（强调句：it is...that...强调主语）

front: The fact that he succeeded surprised everyone.
back: 他成功这一事实让所有人感到惊讶。（同位语从句：that引导从句作fact的同位语）

front: What makes this discovery significant is its practical application.
back: 使这一发现意义重大的是它的实际应用。（主语从句：what引导作主语）

front: The more you read，the better you understand.
back: 读得越多，理解越好。（the more...the more 比较结构）

front: Had he studied harder，he would have passed the exam.
back: 如果他更努力学习，他就会通过考试了。（虚拟语气：had+过去分词 = if倒装）

front: It is generally agreed that education plays a vital role in development.
back: 人们普遍认为教育在发展中起着至关重要的作用。（it引导形式主语，that从句是真正主语）
